name: Last Sunset
source:
After surviving a motorcycle accident that killed your girlfriend, you start over at a new university, hoping to escape the past.
But as strange things begin happening around you, it becomes clear that your new life is tangled with dark secrets.
Something from your past won’t stay buried—and it’s coming for you. Can you unravel the mystery before it consumes you?​
